challenge.results: The operator convention is supported. The inconsistent dollar-iterator and double-underscore-iterator spellings prevent treating the printed example as a literal executable expansion without an editorial correction.

limitations: The rule describes the source-language convention. It carries no promise about an iterator allocation, a particular library interface, or backend optimization.
